from scipy.linalg import solve
class Controller:
 def __init__(self,s):
  self.s=s;self.m=s.model;self.d=s.data;self.n=25
  self.r=self.m.actuator_ctrlrange.copy();self.k=self.m.actuator_gainprm[:,0];self.kd=-self.m.actuator_biasprm[:,2]

  self.prev={};self.log=[]
 def jac(self,site=None,body=None,com=False):
  jp=np.zeros((3,self.m.nv));jr=jp.copy()
  if com:mujoco.mj_jacSubtreeCom(self.m,self.d,jp,1)
  elif site is not None:mujoco.mj_jacSite(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,site)
  else:mujoco.mj_jacBody(self.m,self.d,jp,jr,body)

 def action(self,com,feet,rot=np.eye(3),arms=None,contacts=(True,True)):

  A=[];b=[]
  def task(J,acc,w,key):
   # Estimate convective acceleration from the changing Jacobian.
   old=self.prev.get(key,J);dot=(J-old)/.02;self.prev[key]=J.copy()
   row=np.zeros((len(J),N));row[:,:n]=J
   A.extend(row*w);b.extend((acc-dot@d.qvel[:n])*w)
  jp,_=self.jac(com=True);p=d.subtree_com[1];v=jp@d.qvel[:n]
  task(jp,100*(np.array(com)-p)-20*v,2,'com')
  _,jr=self.jac(body=12);R=d.xmat[12].reshape(3,3);err=sum((np.cross(R[:,i],rot[:,i]) for i in range(3)))/2
  task(jr,100*err-20*jr@d.qvel[:n],2,'rot')
  Jc=[]
  for k in range(2):
   jp,jr=self.jac(site=1+k);p=d.site_xpos[1+k];R=d.site_xmat[1+k].reshape(3,3)
   tar=feet[k];targetrot=rot
   e=sum((np.cross(R[:,i],targetrot[:,i]) for i in range(3)))/2
   task(jp,150*(tar-p)-24*(jp@d.qvel[:n]),4 if contacts[k] else 2,'fp'+str(k))
   task(jr,100*e-20*jr@d.qvel[:n],2 if contacts[k] else .5,'fr'+str(k))

  J=np.zeros((19,n));J[:,6:]=np.eye(19)
  task(J,30*(qref-d.qpos[7:26])-8*d.qvel[6:25],.15,'q')
  A=np.array(A);b=np.array(b)
  H=A.T@A+np.diag(np.r_[np.ones(n)*.001,np.tile([.00001]*3+[.001]*3,nc)])
  g=-A.T@b
  E=np.zeros((6,N));E[:,:n]=M[:6];E[:,n:]=-Jc.T[:6];f=-bias[:6]

  K=np.block([[H,E.T],[E,np.zeros((6,6))]])
  sol=solve(K,np.r_[-g,f],assume_a='sym')[:N]
